object_description: four offset building volumes forming a compact ensemble
design_condition: Four offset volumes occupy the site, frame the boulevard, create generous east and west open spaces aligned with neighbouring housing, and connect these spaces through a green band along the city stream.

positive.statement: The staggering creates clearly readable entrances to the campus.
The boulevard is spatially framed and ends in a generous open space offered to the district.
The main hall creates an unexpected generosity that benefits the campus and its identity.
The distribution of uses and individual room groupings are optimally solved.
The main entrances are convincing and the campus parts are coherently connected by internal access.
The simple, compact volume promises economical and sustainable construction.

negative.statement: The city stream is not opened along the entire required length.
The quality of the boulevard and the public appeal of its long covered area are questioned.
The office and catering areas still require optimization.
The flexibility of the floor plan is somewhat limited by the chosen structure.
The boulevard coverage violates zoning regulations and carries a substantial regulatory risk.
